iterazioni_dettaglio.ragionamento: To disprove Wilson primality for 7, I just need to check that 6! + 1 = 721 isn't divisible by 49, since 721 = 49·14 + 35. I'll write this as a decidable check in the file.

attempts.soluzione:
import FormalConjecturesUtil

namespace WilsonPrime

/-- A Wilson prime is a prime $p$ such that $p^2 \mid (p-1)!+1$. -/
def IsWilsonPrime (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ (p - 1).factorial + 1

/-- The prime $7$ is not a Wilson prime. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem not_isWilsonPrime_seven : ¬ IsWilsonPrime 7 := by
  intro h
  have h2 := h.2
  have : (7 - 1).factorial + 1 = 721 := by decide
  rw [this] at h2
  omega

end WilsonPrime
